data.one_liner: A state management and dependency injection library inspired by Riverpod and async_redux.
data.what_it_does: Provides a notifier-focused state management system that handles app state and services via providers. Supports synchronous and asynchronous states, Redux-style actions, and high-traceability debugging tools.
use_when: You want Riverpod-like type-safe providers without custom widget consumers
You need Redux-style action dispatching combined with standard state notifiers
You want built-in support for debugging observers, event tracing, and an inspector
avoid_when: You prefer automatic provider disposal (autodispose) without manual ref.dispose calls
You already rely heavily on Riverpod or Bloc and do not wish to introduce a new paradigm
strengths: Supports multiple paradigms including Notifier, AsyncNotifier, and ReduxNotifiers
Native Flutter integration using BuildContext extensions without custom widget wrappers
Extensive tracing, debugging, and testing capabilities
weaknesses: Providers are not disposed automatically and require explicit management or view models
Smaller ecosystem and community compared to Riverpod or Bloc
data.setup_notes: Wrap your root app widget with RefenaScope.

alternatives.name: riverpod
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer auto-dispose behavior and a larger ecosystem of official extensions.

alternatives.name: bloc
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want a strictly event-driven state machine with a massive community and extensive tooling.

alternatives.name: provider
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need a simpler, battle-tested InheritedWidget wrapper for dependency injection and state sharing.
